metadata.dcterms:title: LANDEN TRANSFORMATIONS AND THE INTEGRATION OF RATIONAL FUNCTIONS
metadata.dcterms:creator: BOROS, GEORGE
MOLL, VICTOR H.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We present a rational version of the classical Landen transfor- mation for elliptic integrals. This is employed to obtain explicit closed-form expressions for a large class of integrals of even rational functions and to de- velop an algorithm for numerical integration of these functions.
